title: Upper limits for result values per event
objective: Agree and verify upper limits for unreasonable result values in every event.
steps: Agree an upper limit per event with the product owner.
In a TP- competition, enter a value just below, at and above the limit for each event.
Check the message and that above-limit values are not saved, also after a page reload.
expected_result: Values above the agreed limit are rejected with a clear message and are not saved.
reason_manual: Needs a product decision on the limits before it can be automated.

title: Rank within each event
objective: Confirm how rank within an event is meant to be shown and check it once it is defined.
steps: Review the requirement and any design for event rank with the product owner.
Give three competitors different 100m results in a TP- competition.
Check where each competitor's 100m rank is shown, and that a tie shares the rank.
expected_result: The agreed event rank is visible for each competitor and event.
reason_manual: The presentation of event rank is not defined in a design reference.

title: Heptathlon result entry and points
objective: Check that a Heptathlon result can be saved and that its points equal the World Athletics table.
steps: Create one competition of type Heptathlon whose name starts with TP-.
Add a competitor and save 100m Hurdles 14.00 s.
Compare the points with the reference value (978) and check the Heptathlon standings.
expected_result: The result is shown under 100m Hurdles and the points equal the reference value.
reason_manual: A second competition was outside the confirmed state-change limits (create_competition once per audit).

title: CSV export with special characters in names
objective: Find which characters the app accepts in names and check that the CSV keeps them intact.
steps: Try names with apostrophe, accents (for example Åsa) and other characters to see which are accepted.
Add each accepted name to a TP- competition with a result and export the CSV.
Open the CSV with a CSV parser and compare each name with the table.
expected_result: Every name in the CSV equals the name in the table.
reason_manual: Names with comma and quote are rejected by the app, so the planned data could not be created.

title: Page width at 375 px
objective: Find what makes the page 8 px wider than a 375 px viewport and judge it against a design reference.
steps: Open the app at 375 px width with a real device or devtools.
Scroll horizontally on the page outside the table.
Compare with the design reference and note the element that overflows.
expected_result: No page-level horizontal scroll, unless the design allows it.
reason_manual: No design reference exists and the overflowing element was not identified.
